items.stem: Which statements distinguish autocorrelation and heteroscedasticity? A. Autocorrelation is cross-time covariance. B. Heteroscedasticity is non-constant conditional variance. C. They are the same assumption. D. Both can affect conventional OLS inference.
items.explanation: A, B and D are true; the two concepts are distinct.
